serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: Eh…
#Policewoman.Face.normal
Policewoman: I recognize you. You live in the area, right?
You: Yeah…
Policewoman: What’s so important that it can’t wait for tomorrow?
You: I guess it could wait, but I was waiting here for so long…
Policewoman: Whatever. Let’s get it over with. Show me the papers. 
You: Here you go.
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: This is some serious stuff.
You: What will be done about it?
Policewoman: Just to make sure. You are not able to recognize that man who was at the crime scene, correct?
You: Yes, it was dark. Maybe by the voice, that I remember clearly.
Policewoman: Alright. Let’s go there and check out the place.
You: N-now? It’s kind of late…
Policewoman: You want to bother me before my shift and then chicken out?
She wants to help me so let’s just do whatever she wants.
You: Ok, let’s go there.
Policewoman: We will ride in my car…
